summary: A Yorkville cosmetic practice appears to lose enquiries to dead menu links, an email link that may not open and no online booking.

findings.problem: The About Us and Dental Services menu items appear to link to #, and the Email Us link appears to lack a mailto prefix.
findings.cost: Patients cannot reach key pages, and tapping to email may do nothing.
findings.fix: Working menu pages and a proper email link.

findings.problem: Book an Appointment appears with no booking form or scheduler, so every route is a phone call or email, and the only hours shown are Mon to Fri 8am to 5pm.
findings.cost: Patients who want to book online or after hours go elsewhere.
findings.fix: An online booking form and complete hours.

findings.problem: The phone link title appears to read About Dr. Borovac, service card links appear titled for different services, and one service appears under two different page addresses.
findings.cost: Mismatched labels and duplicate pages confuse patients and search engines.
findings.fix: Correct labels and one page per service.

findings.problem: Gallery and blog cards appear to be blank placeholders, no testimonials appear, and a Covid-19 preparedness page appears to remain linked.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients buy on visible results and current information.
findings.fix: A results gallery, reviews and current content.
